Third-party license archive for Small Fortunes 0.9.0

See ../THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt for the human-readable package index and
manifest.json for exact versions, source paths and license SHA-256 checksums.

18 original LICENSE files were copied byte-for-byte from installed production
dependencies. Fiber's npm distribution omits LICENSE; its complete original
MIT license was supplied from the official corresponding v9.8.1 source tag
and copied unchanged. No separate NOTICE files were found in these packages.
Bundled React reconciler notices were extracted from Fiber's distributed code,
and the full corresponding Meta MIT license is copied from installed React.

The inventory covers all 20 non-dev lockfile package entries, including type
packages. Noto Sans SC uses its existing exact package license and upstream
OFL in the parent directory; those files were not modified.

Uninstalled optional Expo/React Native peers and development-only build tools
are not browser runtime dependencies in this distribution. Meshoptimizer is
used only by the offline asset-generation script, not sent to the browser.

The embedded reconciler has no separately installed package.json to establish
its exact standalone version. Its Meta copyright and MIT terms are preserved.
